title: PgWire protocol smoke readiness for production benchmark adapters
scope: BenchBase/JDBC/pgbench prerequisite protocol coverage in FusionDB-bench
constraints: Do not claim official benchmark readiness from protocol smoke alone
Do not require psql/psycopg/JDBC artifacts for the first local smoke
Keep smoke self-contained and repeatable from FusionDB-bench

steps.step: Validate PgWire smoke against release FusionDB
Document PgWire smoke in bench README

benchmark_changes: added pgwire_smoke.py as a self-contained PostgreSQL wire protocol smoke runner
validated cleartext auth, simple query, extended query metadata, parameterized execution, and COPY FROM STDIN CSV
documented pgwire_smoke.py usage in FusionDB-bench README
tests: python -m py_compile pgwire_smoke.py fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py external_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py
